module: Preview of the rally note (pacenotes) editor when no note is selected. Far from the road (beyond overviewDistance), draws the whole road in a rainbow gradient with one marker per note; near the road, only draws the window around the point the camera is aimed at, with the labels of the neighboring notes. A model (points, distances, sorted note entries) is cached in pacenoteToolsState.
notes: Cache: pacenoteToolsState._noSelectionPreviewModel (invalidated if path, snaproad or points change) and _noSelectionPreviewRaycastCache; invalidate() deletes both.
Overview: the route is split into at most 700 segments (overviewMaxRouteSegments). Rainbow color = position along the route (0 red, 1 blue).
opts.labelMode == 'all' shows all labels; otherwise only those of the notes around the pivot (opts.nearCameraCount, default 3).
The pivot search is limited to overviewDistance * 1.25 around the camera, the last pivot and a point ahead on the ray.

invalidate.desc: Deletes the preview's model and ray cache; call when the notebook or the snaproad changes.

draw.desc: Draws the no-selection preview (route and notes via pacenote:drawDebugPacenoteNoSelectionRainbow).

drawOnTop.desc: true to draw without depth test.

returns.desc: true if something was drawn, false if the data is insufficient.

nearWindow.desc: Returns the route window near the camera used by the near view, without drawing.

returns.desc: {startDistance, endDistance, pivotDistance, pivotPos} or nil (no notes, camera too far or missing data).
